# Charge pump P-101 operating manual

## 3 Mechanical seal

Renew the mechanical seal cartridge on the charge pump every 8000 running hours or at the first sign of leakage past the gland.

## 4 Suction conditions

The net positive suction head available shall exceed the NPSH required by at least 1.5 m at rated flow. Throttling the suction valve is prohibited.
